desc: Write full solution code: parse H, W and row strings into masks; build frequency array f of size 2^W.
Build g[v] = min(popcount(v), W − popcount(v)) via two-pass DP (popcount pass, then min pass).
Implement tight iterative in-place FWHT; transform f and g, pointwise multiply, inverse transform with division by 2^W.
Output min over c of convolution result.
Fix g construction to the two-pass version and verify against samples (2, 0, 13) and edge cases (W=1, all-zero rows, H=1).
